title: An infinitesimal deformation of the post-Lie and post-Hopf algebra correspondence
summary: We describe infinitesimal deformations of post-Lie algebras and post-Hopf algebras and prove that the adjunction given by the universal enveloping algebra and primitive elements functors is compatible with the infinitesimal structure. When restricted to connected and cocommutative infinitesimal post-Hopf algebras, this becomes an equivalence of categories, which constitutes an extension of the Cartier--Milnor--Moore theorem.
